## Santosh Ayer

I am a graduate researcher in Forest Biology and Management at the University
of Alberta, Canada, supported through a Graduate Research Assistant Fellowship.
My graduate research evaluates how forest growth-and-yield models represent
forest responses to thinning, including their implications for stand
development and forest management.

My broader research develops transparent and practical approaches for forest
inventory, allometry, biomass estimation, growth modelling, and carbon
accounting, with a particular focus on Nepal.

I want to contribute to Nepal's forestry sector by developing accessible,
scientifically defensible tools that connect forestry research with education
and operational forest management.

[Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.ca/citations?user=gjUyDikAAAAJ&hl=en) ·
[GitHub](https://github.com/ayersant-sys)

## About this package

Santosh Ayer is the developer and maintainer of `nepalallometry`. The package
implements published models but does not claim authorship of the underlying
equations. Each model, dataset, regulatory document, and conversion factor is
credited to its original source through the package reference registry.

```{r references, eval=FALSE}
allometry_references()
```
